name: levelcode-shell
description: A shell for the files of this workspace, in the browser tab: a terminal panel for you, and the engine behind the agent's commands.

viewsWelcome.contents:
A shell for the files in this workspace, running in your browser. It runs shell scripts and common commands such as ls, cat, grep, sed and find; it does not start programs such as node, npm, python or git.
[Open LevelCode Shell](command:levelcode.shell.new)
The agent's commands show up here as well.

enumDescriptions: Open the terminal panel for the first command the agent runs in this session, and only add to the tab after that.
Show the agent's tab every time it runs a command, unless you are typing in another terminal.
Never open the panel for the agent. The tab is there when you look for it.
levelcode.shell.revealAgentRuns.markdownDescription: Whether the terminal panel opens by itself when the agent runs a command.

levelcode.shell.historySize.markdownDescription: How many commands the shell remembers between visits, in this browser. `0` keeps none.
